title: Leaving the test sources out: --exclude-tests and [analysis] excludeTests
description: main.bal has 1 core issue; tests/main_test.bal has 2 core issues (one suppressed) and a suppression that matches nothing. The analyzer adds one issue per document. With the tests excluded, only main.bal's core and analyzer issues remain, the unmatched-suppression warning is gone, and the HTML report does not list main_test.bal. Not available before 0.13.0. --exclude-tests takes an optional true/false value and overrides [analysis] excludeTests either way: written alone it means true, and --exclude-tests=false scans the tests even when Scan.toml leaves them out.

steps.name: --exclude-tests --scan-report
steps.note: Open the HTML report: main_test.bal is not listed.

steps.note: Passes: 2 issues are left once the tests are excluded.

steps.name: --exclude-tests=false overrides Scan.toml
steps.note: The test file is scanned again despite excludeTests = true: its issues and the unmatched-suppression warning are back. Earlier builds take no value for the option and reject it.

steps.note: Scan.toml has 2 errors; nothing is scanned.
